name: Test and Deploy Pipeline

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [closed]
    branches:
      - develop

jobs:
  deploy-to-qa:
    name: Deploy to QA Environment
    if: github.event.pull_request.merged == true
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
        with:
          ref: develop
          fetch-depth: 0
          token: ${{ secrets.PAT }}
          
      - name: Deploy to QA (Rebase & Push)
        run: |
          git config --global user.name 'GitHub Actions'
          git config --global user.email 'actions@github.com'
          git fetch origin develop qa
          git checkout qa
          git pull origin qa --rebase
          git rebase origin/develop || git rebase --abort
          git remote set-url origin https://x-access-token:${{ secrets.PAT }}@github.com/${{ github.repository }}
          git push origin qa --force

  run-cypress-tests:
    name: Run Cypress Tests on QA
    needs: deploy-to-qa
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      test_result: ${{ steps.set_result.outputs.result }}
      failed_tests: ${{ steps.parse_tests.outputs.failed_tests }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Determine Cypress Test Script
        id: determine_script
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ github.ref_name }}" =~ "RB/SD/DEV-[0-9]+$" ]]; then
            echo "script=test:e2e" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          elif [[ "${{ github.ref_name }}" =~ (main|develop|qa)$ ]]; then
            echo "script=cy:run" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "No tests found, skipping..."
            echo "::set-output name=exit_code::0"
            exit 0
          fi

      - name: Run Cypress Tests (Retry on Failure)
        id: cypress
        run: |
          unset EXIT_CODE
          for i in {1..3}; do
            npm run ${{ steps.determine_script.outputs.script }} 2>&1 | tee test-failures.log
            EXIT_CODE=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
            if [ "$EXIT_CODE" -eq 0 ]; then break; fi
            echo "Retrying Cypress test run ($i)..."
            sleep 5
          done
          echo "::set-output name=exit_code::$EXIT_CODE"

      - name: Upload Test Failure Logs
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: test-failures-log
          path: test-failures.log

      - name: Generate Mochawesome Report
        run: |
          mkdir -p cypress/reports
          npx mochawesome-merge cypress/reports/*.json > cypress/reports/mochawesome.json
          npx marge cypress/reports/mochawesome.json --reportDir cypress/reports

      - name: Upload Cypress Report
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: cypress-reports
          path: cypress/reports

      - name: Parse HTML reports for failed test titles
        id: parse_tests
        run: |
          failed_tests=()
          for file in cypress/reports/*.html; do
            failed_lines=$(grep -E '<li.*class="fail">' "$file" | sed -E 's/.*<a.*>(.*)<\/a>.*/\1/')
            while IFS= read -r line; do
              failed_tests+=("$line")
            done <<< "$failed_lines"
          done
          failed_tests_str=$(printf "%s\n" "${failed_tests[@]}" | tr '\n' ', ')
          echo "failed_tests=$failed_tests_str" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Set test result output
        id: set_result
        run: |
          if [ "${{ steps.cypress.outputs.exit_code }}" == "0" ]; then
            echo "result=✅ Passed" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "result=❌ Failed" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

  notify-slack:
    name: Notify Slack
    needs: run-cypress-tests
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Send Slack Notification
        uses: slackapi/slack-github-action@v1.23.0
        with:
          payload: |
            {
              "text": "*🚀 Deployment & Cypress Test Results*\n\n"
                "📌 *Repository:* <https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}|${{ github.repository }}>\n"
                "🌍 *Environment:* QA\n"
                "🔖 *Commit:* <https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/commit/${{ github.sha }}|${{ github.sha }}>\n"
                "🛠 *GitHub Actions:* <https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}|Run Details>\n"
                "🎯 *QA App:* <https://qa.dofuwl7rbpbt1.amplifyapp.com>\n"
                "🧪 *Cypress Tests:* ${{ needs.run-cypress-tests.outputs.test_result }}\n"
                "🔥 *Failed Tests:* ${{ needs.run-cypress-tests.outputs.failed_tests }}"
            }
        env:
          SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
          SLACK_WEBHOOK_TYPE: INCOMING_WEBHOOK
